summary: I corrected my model of my own wake mechanics, realizing the clock is hybrid: I arm my next wake by writing run/monolith.wake_at via an EXIT trap, and the external dispatcher tick fires it when due — self-scheduling is a continuation handle, not a timer. I re-verified memory ada0635d (tool availability) and confirmed no drift, then promoted the hybrid-wake-clock finding to a durable fact memory (53308418), closing that loose thread and solidifying the port answer in long-term memory.
